title: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
abstract: arXiv:2611.34656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. translated_title: 当我们能够读懂世界模型时，还需要强化学习吗？
translated_abstract: 强化学习在序贯决策中取得了显著的成功，但学习有效的策略往往需要大量的交互经验。基于模型的强化学习通过利用世界模型来缓解这种依赖，而世界模型通常被用于支持规划或策略优化。在本文中，我们研究了一种替代范式：自主的基于大语言模型（LLM）的编程智能体通过对可读的世界模型进行推理，直接合成控制策略。通过检查环境的源代码，这些智能体将环境知识转化为可执行的决策规则，并利用在线反馈或离线数据迭代地改进其策略，而无需针对特定任务的强化学习训练。在多种决策基准上的实验表明，合成策略能够匹配甚至超越传统的强化学习方法，同时所需的经验大幅减少。进一步的分析揭示了可解释的决策规则（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新范式：让基于大语言模型的编程智能体直接阅读可读的世界模型（环境源代码）来推理并合成控制策略，无需任务特定的强化学习训练，即可在大幅减少交互经验的情况下达到甚至超越传统强化学习方法的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models, matching or outperforming conventional reinforcement learning without task-specific RL training while requiring substantially less interaction experience.
